name: work
description: Ties each Claude session to its Linear issue through the herdr board. Agents write Linear with Linear's own MCP tools; the plugin's hook tells the board about every write, a SessionStart hook names the session's issue, column and marks, and start and layout create bound worktrees. A rules skill carries the write rules. Needs a herdr-board release with `board linear report`; run `/work setup` to install and connect everything, or see docs/cutover.md to move from 0.5.
